note: Hardin County Conservation park on the Iowa River ~1 mi E of Union, site of the 1856 grist mill, with on-site camp hosts. The river-access boat ramp was posted 'currently in need of repair and unsafe for use' (read 2026-11-02). Sites accommodate ~25 ft, so a 23-ft Class C fits. --Claude
summary: 35 electric, FCFS, showers, dump confirmed on the county's mycountyparks page; season April-October. hardincountyia.gov refused (403), not retried: fees stay on AWH's 2026-10-16 read. Riverview lead for south row.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD, stored 'not waterfront' looks too low for the south row. Esri z19 leaf-off at 42.2480,-93.0434: two pad groups. North loop (42.2502,-93.0440) is about 100 m+ from the river through forest. South row of about 8 back-in pads off the park road (42.2478-42.2487,-93.0434), rear ends about 15-25 m from the Iowa River, with no road between them and the water, only a narrow strip of bare-branched trees. River about 30 m wide at those pads, riffly. The strip of trees rules out riverfront on the open-apron rule, unless AWH reads it as scattered trees; a view through it from those pads looks certain in leaf-off and filtered in summer. So riverview. No official campsite photo was found to settle the summer view.

UNREAD: https://hardincountyia.gov/daisy-long and www.hardincountyia.gov answered 403 (Cloudflare, as the stored provenance says); not retried by another route. Fees ($20/$25), the 50-amp value and the ~25 ft statement stay as stored, unverified by me. The 2026-10-16 fee note (AWH's browser read) mentions monthly rates of $450/$600 by application with the host; imagery shows a few rigs but no sign it is mainly long-stay.
Max 25 ft: no page I could read states it. Pads on z19 look about 15 m (~50 ft) long, so 23 ft fits on the imagery as well.
Pin falls on the bank between the two pad groups, within ~100 m of both; fine. Phone 641-648-4361 confirmed (mycountyparks county contact, Hardin County Conservation).
